doc.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025

title: Pots and pans music with Dr. John and Willie DeVille
summary: Conte recalls a record with Willie DeVille where Dr. John told him to play pots and pans music.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: You know one day you might get a call from a producer and say, “Luis, can you bring like your pots and pans?”

Hey, that happened to me with Dr. John. We were doing a record with an artist named Willie DeVille and Matt was producing. And the first tune I go, “Hey man, what do you want me to play on this, man?” You know we were playing it live. He goes, “Man, you know what to do, this is pots and pans music.” I go, “Okay.”
And I thought I was making a joke.
